thread:
jonah: Heads up — found an SDK/REST parity bug affecting batch embeddings. REST has POST /v1/embeddings/batch that accepts "inputs": [..] but the Node SDK method `embeddings.createBatch()` only sends a single `input` field, so downstream code only gets the first embedding.
maria.chen: can you paste the curl vs SDK example?
jonah: sure:
```
# REST (works)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-1","inputs":["a","b","c"]}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch | jq
# => {"model":"embed-1","data":[{"embedding":...},{"embedding":...},{"embedding":...}]}

# Node SDK (broken)
const res = await client.embeddings.createBatch({ model: 'embed-1', input: ['a','b','c'] })
// => res.data.length == 1  // only first input processed
```
charlie: interesting — why is the SDK sending `input` instead of `inputs`?
jonah: serializer snippet shows `params['input'] = Array.isArray(p) ? p[0] : p` — someone assumed `input` could be an array and just pulled first element. Oops.
maria.chen: that's nasty. Any failing tests?
ci-bot: sampleapp/tests/embeddings/test_batch_embeddings.py::test_multiple_inputs  — 1 failed. CI log: ci://artifacts/2111112200/batch_embed.log
charlie: proposed fix: change SDK surface to accept `inputs` (plural) and preserve arrays as arrays when sending JSON body; add alias for backwards compatibility that transforms `input` => `inputs` if needed. Update TypeScript types to show inputs: string[] | Array<string|EmbeddingInput>.
jonah: I'll open a PR to update Node, Python, and Go SDKs to accept `inputs` and to ensure body serializer doesn't collapse arrays to single values. Also add a regression test that sends 3 inputs and asserts 3 embeddings returned.
maria.chen: also update docs and quickstart sample: current sample shows `input: 'hello'` for single and `input: ['a','b']` for batch — ambiguous. Make examples explicit: `input: '...'` vs `inputs: ['...']`.
charlie: please also add an integration test in sampleapp that calls REST payload and SDK call and asserts parity. Might catch other pluralization mismatches.
jonah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1350 — changes parameter name, serializer, types, tests, and CHANGELOG.
ci-bot: CI queued for sdk/pull/1350 on node14 and py39.
maria.chen: filed a scan issue to find other plural vs singular inconsistencies: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/210 (param-plurals-parity-scan)
charlie: nice catch, thanks Jonah. We'll fast-track review and backport if it's present in maintenance branches. :raised_hands:
